component.name: Naviamp
component.summary: Music player for Navidrome and other music libraries

description.p: Browse, discover, queue, download, and play music from Navidrome, Subsonic and OpenSubsonic servers, Jellyfin, and Bandcamp.
Manage playlists and your listening queue, explore your library, and listen offline. Connect to your own music server to get started.
